integrity: The transfer proof is deductive. The executable artifact checks only arithmetic and polynomial-system bookkeeping and is not represented as a computation of tensor rank or of a Nullstellensatz certificate.
scientific_limitations: The positive-characteristic result gives only a finite exceptional set, not an explicit list of exceptional primes.
The result is restricted to two and three direct-sum copies because those are the cases with published exact complex lower bounds.
The proof transfers Li's lower bounds; it does not independently rederive the source's long tensor-rank arguments.
title: Arithmetic persistence of Comon rank gaps two and three
